environment.privacy: Host name, processor, memory and operating-system details are intentionally omitted from repository evidence.

stepsPerRoom: fetch local JSON through the browser
validate and compile the level document
initialize the Game runtime at the default spawn and every authored entrance
render at least one browser frame

statusPolicy.reason: A load sweep does not prove route completion, death/reset behavior, feel, fidelity, or chapter/area continuous play. Per-room browser and continuousRun statuses remain separate.
